policy: A re-collection is promoted into tier A when it is the same cell on the same gpu_name as the tier-A job it answers for. The corpus records no CPU, RAM or OS -- driver_version is the only host field any parquet carries -- so a stricter 'same hardware configuration' test is not checkable, and tier A does not hold the driver constant either (RTX 5080 spans 576.83 and 581.95). Drivers are recorded on both sides below so a reader can judge.
